Name: Crystalberry Bushes in the Winter
Author: scrotorrr
Description:
IRL I love picking wild berries and I wanted my farmer to have the ability to do so year-round.  This mod adds Crystalberries, a member of the Crystal Fruit family, as a forageable bush fruit.  They have a 100% chance to bloom on every berry bush on your map, so get to pickin'!

Thanks to fwippy for making the Huckleberry assets free to use with credit :)   Being a very novice modder, I relied heavily on their Huckleberry Season mod for guidance and inspiration.

Compatible with SVE, RSV, East Scarp, Walk to the Desert, and Auto Forager.  Is compatible with any map with berry bushes afaik.
